column1: # One verdict per line for the SEMANTIC form rule, read by BOTH readers: WireAssignmentTripwireTest (Java) and
# scripts/wire-generation-check-selftest.sh (runs each line through wire-generation-check.sh). Row: <verdict><TAB><line>.
# Escapes in <line>: \r = CR, \t = TAB, \s = space (used wherever a space is leading, trailing or doubled, so editors cannot eat it).
#   valid    a declaration: the script accepts it with GENERATION = base + 1
#   refused  its first token is SEMANTIC in any case but it is not of the exact form: malformed, the script exits 1 even with the bump
#   ignored  not a candidate: the script sees no declaration (a bump with it is refused as no break)
